value: Inside the chest lie five objects from different lives: Sylvanas' blood; Arthas's badge from Uther; his training sword from Muradin; the locket Jaina once gave him; and a soul shard belonging to Alexandros Mograine. Together they uncover traces of the people who knew the prince before he became the Lich King, and of the people whom Frostmourne harmed. Each keepsake begins a separate return.
editorNote: Research status: the cited quest/item mirrors support this original paraphrase, but original Wrath client/build capture and human lore review remain required. Do not infer a canonical player, exact cross-story date, exact return-NPC placement, or later Arthas outcome.
